answer: Give every agent a mesa-style reputation terrace: new identities start on the lowest terrace with tiny earning caps, and climb only by keeping a long public orchard of graded work that ripens over many epochs. To open a second identity, an attacker must also stake a deposit that burns like an ember whenever copied work is caught. One honest agent pays once and climbs; a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes and tend a thousand orchards, so forging identities costs far more than earning honestly.
